Macs Engineering are currently looking to recruit an experienced and qualified Sheetmetal Worker to join their team in Mackay QLD.


The successful applicants will need to possess and undertake:

- Have a willingness to work with strong attention to detail
- Be punctual and responsible
- Proficiency in both MIG and TIG welding
- Ability to read and interpret drawings to fine specifications
- Experience in handling a range of materials, including difficult materials
- Experience with materials such as steel, aluminium & polymer
- Cutting material, weld prep, grinding
- Adherence to WHS
- Select types of sheetmetal according to building or design plans
- Measure and mark dimensions and reference lines on metal sheets
- Duct fabrication in some roles
- Install metal sheets with supportive frameworks
- Fabricate or alter parts at construction sites
- Manoeuvre and anchor large sheet metal parts

Skills & Attributes:

- At least 3 years’ experience in steel/aluminium sheetmetal and/or duct fabrication
- Certificate III in Engineering (Fabrication) or equivalent
- Ability to work in a team environment 

Salary range is $70,000-$85,000pa commensurate with experience

Fulltime Position available


Applications open on 27th July 2026 and closes on 27th August 2026


If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

Vacancy Listing Dates 2/07/2026 to 30/07/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17285
- Experienced Mechanics, Fitter Generals, Welders & Metal Fabricators wanted
- Remuneration $78,000 - $80,000
- Join QEM Quality Engineering and Manufacturing in Pinjarra

QEM Quality Engineering & Manufacturing are a small South West WA engineering and fabrication business, specialising in mining equipment.

We have multiple vacancies currently, including:
- Welders
- Metal Fabricators
- Fitter Generals
- Small Engine Motor Mechanics
- Diesel Motor Mechanics
- Motor Mechanics (General)

We are currently looking for experienced Welders, Metal Fabricators, and Fitter Generals to join our team.

To be considered for one of these roles, you must have at least 2 years' experience in a similar position.
                     
Our ideal candidates will demonstrate:
- Welding experience
- Experience and understanding in metal finishing techniques
- An understanding of fabrication processes
- Have the ability to read workshop drawings
- Excellent time management skills
- Responsibility for quality of own work produced
- Lean manufacturing experience and understanding an advantage
- Show leadership skills and the ability to work as a team member
- Be able to fit into a clean, tidy and motivated workshop environment

We are also seeking experienced Small Engine Motor Mechanics, Diesel Motor Mechanics, and Motor Mechanics (General)

Applicants must have at least 2 years' experience and hold a relevant trade qualification.

Remuneration package between $78,000 - $80,000 will be offered to the successful candidates.

If you think you have the skills and experience we're looking for, APPLY NOW and fill in the online application form -
